issues.description: The documentation command passes only local and Verus crates to rustdoc, omitting registry dependency --extern mappings and their artifact search directory, so targets importing registry crates cannot resolve those imports.
issues.rationale: generate_single_target_doc launches rustdoc directly with edition 2021. Its --extern arguments enumerate Verus builtins/vstd and get_local_dependency only; registry crates are not put into the extern prelude, and release/deps is not searched. The same selected OSTD manifest depends on registry bitflags and log and active x86 sources import them. Merely placing rlibs in a -L path does not introduce extern-prelude names. The immediate parent/child repair updates the pinned DV from 55b3285a to 19962d96; its sole code change obtains get_remote_dependency, checks the resolved artifacts, pushes --extern arguments and adds -L dependency=release/deps. This is a missing dependency-resolution input in the documented build tool, not a claim that the wait implementation itself is defective.
issues.verification: source-only project adjudication; historical Verus and full historical project rustdoc were not executed. Independent Rust/rustdoc 1.88.0 micro-reproduction with a separately built remote_dep crate produced E0432 with only -L deps and succeeded with --extern remote_dep=... plus -L dependency=deps. This demonstrates argument-resolution semantics, not full-project execution. Complete doc command and fixed submodule diff inspected.
